tasks.gr11-statistics-t4: Topic: Statistics. Cover constructing and interpreting histograms, frequency polygons and ogives (cumulative frequency curves); calculating variance and standard deviation as measures of spread; identifying positive and negative skewness from graphs and summary statistics (comparing mean, median, mode); and recognising and interpreting outliers. Ask Grade 11 learners to read and draw statistical displays, calculate standard deviation from ungrouped data, describe distribution shape, and comment on the effect of outliers on summary measures.
tasks.gr11-revision-exam-prep-t4: Topic: Revision and Final Examination Preparation. Provide targeted consolidation across all Grade 11 Mathematics topics — Paper 1 (algebra, equations, number patterns, functions, finance, probability) and Paper 2 (analytical geometry, trigonometry, Euclidean geometry, statistics). Ask Grade 11 learners to solve Paper 1 and Paper 2 style questions, recall and apply circle theorems, manage exam time, and address common errors in proofs, graph interpretation and multi-step algebraic problems.
